title: Type to filter
text: Filters options by contains or starts with as the user types, without selecting automatically.

title: Async options
text: Loads options from a server with debouncing and cancellation of stale requests.

title: Accessible pattern
text: Follows the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern with focus kept on the input.

title: Top layer popup
text: The list opens in the browser top layer and stays positioned next to the input.

title: Custom option content
text: Render your own option content while the label stays the accessible name.
